description: Synthetic public benchmark shapes matching the incumbent token geometries. Prompt text is generated procedurally by benchmarks/run_bench.py from a neutral filler paragraph written for this repo (no incumbent prompt text). Sizes are target token counts; the harness repeats/truncates the filler by words and reports both word and token counts when a tokenizer is available.

shapes.description: Short request, incumbent patient_gen input geometry with a short decode.
Long request, incumbent research_synth input geometry with a 1024-token decode.
Agent-style requests sharing an 8192-token prefix plus 512 unique tokens each; exercises prefix caching.
